title: Tenant Identity Record and FQDN Semantic Contract
description: Draft semantic contract for tenant identity records, FQDN ownership, and tenant lookup semantics required by the authentication first slice. The first implementation slice requires tenant ownership to fail closed for unresolved hosts, inactive custom domains, and cross-tenant domain ownership conflicts.
aiGuidance: Use this as a source-backed tenant identity contract. Do not infer tenant routing or FQDN ownership from source paths without updating semantic instances.

stateModel.description: Tenant identity state covers known tenant record, verified host/FQDN association, active custom-domain ownership, same-tenant domain reuse, cross-tenant domain conflict, disabled or inactive host ownership, and unresolved host fail-closed outcome.

validation.description: Tenant lookup validation must reject unresolved, unverified, inactive, disabled, or other-tenant host identity before authentication context is trusted. A same-domain ownership conflict must be denied before issuing proof material, callback material, or session context.

errorModel.description: Unresolved, disabled, inactive, or cross-tenant tenant identity fails closed and cannot be replaced by generated report status. Conflict outcomes must not leak ownership proof tokens or silently downgrade to a different tenant.

auditModel.description: The first slice requires denied cross-tenant domain ownership attempts to emit safe audit metadata and prohibits token leakage in rejected conflict outcomes. Detailed full identity audit taxonomy remains a later expansion.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: Tenant identity resolution is a request-context contract for this slice, not a user-facing UI journey.
